security_audit.summary: All 61 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline code, example URLs, relative documentation links, and SEO terminology. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, hidden executable code, or malicious network behavior in the reviewed files. The skill mentions optional audit helpers and write-channel index submission, but they are documented, user-directed, and gated by dry-run or live flags.

content.value_statement: Technical SEO problems can block crawling, indexing, and ranking even when content is strong. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through evidence-based audits and prioritized fixes.
actual_capabilities: Audits crawlability inputs such as robots.txt, sitemaps, crawl samples, redirect chains, and orphan patterns.
Checks indexability signals including noindex, X-Robots-Tag, canonical tags, duplicate clusters, and 4xx or 5xx responses.
Reviews Core Web Vitals metrics and maps LCP, INP, CLS, and TTFB issues to prioritized fixes.
Produces compact scorecards, priority queues, quick wins, 30-day roadmaps, and handoff summaries.
Includes playbooks for bulk URL audits, AI crawler handling, ecommerce patterns, and pre-migration QA.
limitations: It needs URLs, crawl exports, PageSpeed data, or user-provided evidence for measured conclusions.
It does not replace paid crawlers, Search Console access, log analysis, or live engineering validation.
It is not focused on title tags, copy quality, or content refreshes.
Write-channel helpers for index submission require user-owned credentials and explicit live execution.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Indexing Loss
use_cases.description: Find robots.txt, noindex, canonical, sitemap, and response-code problems that keep important pages out of search results.

use_cases.title: Prepare Site Migration
use_cases.description: Create a pre-migration audit with baseline capture, redirect risks, staging QA, launch checks, and post-launch monitoring.

use_cases.title: Audit Large Catalogs
use_cases.description: Group ecommerce URLs by template, sample representative pages, and prioritize fixes that affect many pages.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use technical-seo-checker to audit [URL]. Focus on crawlability, indexability, Core Web Vitals, and the top three fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Review Crawl Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [domain] using this robots.txt, sitemap, and crawl export: [paste links or data]. Mark each finding as measured, user-provided, or estimated.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Migration QA
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a pre-migration technical SEO audit for [old domain] to [new domain]. Include baseline capture, redirect-map risks, staging QA, launch checks, and T+1/T+7/T+30 monitoring.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate Bulk Indexing
prompt_templates.prompt: Bulk audit [number] URLs from [sitemap or export]. Group by template, sample representative pages, identify pattern-level blockers, and produce a P0/P1/P2 repair queue.

output_examples.input: Check technical SEO for a product category page.
output: Crawlability score: 7 out of 10. Sitemap is present, but faceted URLs create crawl waste.
Priority fix: tighten parameter handling and confirm important category pages remain crawlable.
Next check: validate canonicals and Core Web Vitals on representative category templates.

output_examples.input: Prepare a migration audit for an old domain moving to a new domain.
output: Risk level: high until redirect coverage and staging index controls are verified.
Required evidence: URL inventory, top organic pages, backlink targets, redirect map, and staging crawl results.
Launch gate: no production Disallow all rule, no missing redirects for high-value URLs, and no redirect chains.

output_examples.input: Bulk audit 500 ecommerce URLs with indexing problems.
output: Grouped by product, category, blog, and static-page templates.
Sampled representative URLs in each group and reported pattern-level blockers.
Repair queue prioritizes fixes that recover the largest number of indexable commercial pages.

best_practices: Provide current URLs, crawl date, sample size, and source for every measured claim.
Separate measured data, user-provided data, and model estimates in the final report.
Fix P0 crawl and indexation blockers before tuning lower-impact technical hygiene.
anti_patterns: Do not treat example URLs or placeholder metrics as real audit evidence.
Do not run write-channel index submission without verified ownership and explicit live approval.
Do not claim JavaScript-rendered schema is missing until raw and rendered DOM evidence is compared.

faq.question: Does this skill crawl my site by itself?
faq.answer: No. It guides an audit using connected tools, supplied reports, or user-provided URLs and crawl evidence.

faq.question: Can it audit Core Web Vitals?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews LCP, INP, CLS, and TTFB when PageSpeed, CrUX, Lighthouse, or similar evidence is available.

faq.question: Does it handle migrations?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a pre-migration workflow for baselines, redirect maps, staging QA, launch checks, and post-launch monitoring.

faq.question: Is it useful for ecommerce sites?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports bulk audits that group pages by template and prioritize pattern-level fixes across catalogs.

faq.question: Does it write files or submit URLs automatically?
faq.answer: No automatic write action is required. Any saved audit or index submission should require user approval and credentials.

faq.question: What should I use for title tags or content quality?
faq.answer: Use a related on-page or content skill. This skill focuses on technical crawling, indexing, speed, and site infrastructure.
